channel.title: TravelDeals: Travel blog
channel.description: Travel news and holiday guides for UK, US and European travellers: new entry rules, where to find winter sun, city break ideas and money-saving tips.

item.title: GHIC card explained: what it covers abroad and what it doesn’t
item.description: What the UK GHIC card covers in Europe, where it is valid, what it excludes and how to apply free. Plus why you still need travel insurance.

item.title: Flight delay compensation: what you can claim under UK and EU rules
item.description: Flight delayed over 3 hours? See how much flight delay compensation you could claim under UK and EU rules, what airlines must provide and how to claim.

item.title: Black Friday travel deals: how to tell a real saving from a pushy sales pitch
item.description: Black Friday travel deals can be genuine or not. Check the total price, ignore fake urgency and compare flights and holidays properly before you book.

item.title: Passport validity for Europe: the 10-year and 3-month rules, and how to check yours
item.description: Is your passport valid for Europe? GOV.UK says it must be under 10 years old on arrival and have 3 months left on departure. How to check before you book.

item.title: UK airport liquids rule: the 100ml limit, 2-litre airports and what to check
item.description: Can you take more than 100ml in hand luggage? GOV.UK says some UK airports allow 2 litre containers. How to check before you fly and what always gets through.

item.title: How to protect your holiday booking: ATOL, ABTA and paying by credit card
item.description: How to protect your holiday booking: what ATOL and ABTA cover, how paying by credit card can help, and what travel insurance usually does not include.

item.title: Christmas market city breaks: Europe’s best festive getaways
item.description: Plan a festive city break: Europe’s best-known Christmas markets in Germany, Austria, Czechia, France and beyond, when they open and booking tips.

item.title: EES and ETIAS: what Europe’s new border rules mean for your trip
item.description: What the EU Entry/Exit System means for UK and US travellers, when ETIAS will start, and what to expect at the border on your next trip to Europe.

item.title: UK ETA: who needs one, what it costs and how to apply
item.description: Visiting the UK from the US or Europe? Find out who needs an electronic travel authorisation (ETA), what it costs, how long it lasts and how to apply.

item.title: Winter sun: where to find warm weather from November to March
item.description: Short-haul and long-haul winter sun ideas for UK, US and European travellers, from the Canary Islands and Madeira to the Caribbean, Mexico and Dubai.
